candidates.description: This vector represents societal, civic, and political structures and relations.
This vector represents abstract mental constructs, ideas, and theoretical frameworks.
This feature represents the semantic concepts of inclusion, exclusion, permission, and prohibition in actions or terms.
This feature activates for verbs of communication, speech, and argumentation across various tenses and forms.
This vector represents concepts related to religion, faith, and cultural belief systems.
This feature vector activates tokens related to political, ideological, and religious belief systems or affiliations ending in suffixes like "-ist" or "-ism".
This vector represents concepts of power dynamics, hierarchy, and control, contrasting dominance and supremacy with subordination or oppression.
This vector is related to verb-forming suffixes and their morphological variants used to indicate actions, states, or processes.
This vector represents societal and economic challenges, including scarcity, unrest, and systemic crises.
This feature vector represents the concept of intention, purpose, or expectation regarding future actions or outcomes.
